lines.text: The Darkwood. Ancient. Mysterious. Fully permitted.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Remember: we need a hiking permit, a camping permit, and a permit permit. I have NONE of them.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: What happens if we just walk in?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The trees file a complaint. And hero... the trees ARE the complaint department.

lines.speaker: Doreen
lines.text: Sir. SIR. This is a protected bureaucracy. Do you have your MT-7?

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We have an MT-6 and a dream.

lines.speaker: Doreen
lines.text: ...I'm reaching for my whistle now. I want you to know this hurts me more than it hurts you. It won't, though.
In the heart of the wood stands Barkimedes. His branches hold forty thousand pending applications.

lines.speaker: Barkimedes
lines.text: AH. THE APPLICANTS. I HAVE REVIEWED YOUR FILE. IT IS... INCOMPLETE.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: We attached everything! Even the optional section!

lines.speaker: Barkimedes
lines.text: THE OPTIONAL SECTION IS MANDATORY. IT SAYS SO IN THE OPTIONAL SECTION. PREPARE FOR ARBORTRATION.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: That's all we wanted, big guy.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Onward to Mount Grumble! I hear the dwarves are on strike, so mining permits are — oh no. Oh NO. They're free. Something is very wrong.
